title: Distribution: goreleaser, install.sh and a stable install URL
description: Ship ticfac as ticks ships: .goreleaser.yaml producing platform binaries (darwin/linux, amd64/arm64), an install.sh behind a stable URL, and release notes. The install must place ticfac-exec-subprocess beside ticfac.
acceptance_criteria: A machine that has never built ticfac installs it with one command and runs 'ticfac doctor' successfully; a tagged release produces all platform binaries
